title: Claim Look-Back Window for Pocketwire Personal Account Purchase Protection
content:
**Rule.** The claim look-back window of the protection reimbursement on a Pocketwire Personal Account depends on the account's age in calendar days from its opened date: for an account at least 730 days old it covers the last six months, for an account at least 365 but under 730 days old it covers the last nine months, and for a younger account it covers the last twelve months; a claim falls inside a window of N months when its report date is later than the same calendar day N months before the handling date.

The claims counted in the window are the purchase protection claims the customer filed, other than the claim being paid. The account's age is the number of calendar days from the opened date to the handling date.

| Account age (calendar days) | Look-back window |
|---|---|
| 730 or more | Last six months |
| 365 to 729 | Last nine months |
| Up to 364 | Last twelve months |

**Boundary pairs**

| Account age | Window |
|---|---|
| 364 days | Twelve months |
| 365 days | Nine months |
| 729 days | Nine months |
| 730 days | Six months |

**Case (hypothetical, handling date 10 October).** For an account 400 days old the window covers report dates after 10 January of the same year; a claim reported on 10 January is outside it and one reported on 11 January is inside.
